summary: Travel presentation was meaningfully modernized within the allowed template, stylesheet, and test areas. Current and available locations are visually distinct, destination cards use only supplied view-model context, travel actions are prominent and responsive, unavailable destinations are not inferred, and existing POST route, location ID, field name, and submitted value contracts remain intact. Focused tests and the full suite passed: 314 tests passed.
risks: Responsive and visual quality is supported by CSS and presentation tests but was not confirmed through browser-based visual regression testing.
